blocks.x: Hi. I’m Bob Daughtry. Today is Wednesday, May 5th, 2004, Cinco de Mayo. I’m here with George and Alice Russell for the Smithsonian Oral History Project. Katea Stitt is engineering. This is tape 4.
George, you’re looking like you’re hanging better that I am.
That’s a high compliment, for both of us.
Thanks for joining us. We really do appreciate it.
